create_config_align_text: create an AlignTextConfig with default transformer text model settings for ALIGN
create_config_align_vision: create an AlignVisionConfig with default CNN vision model settings for ALIGN
create_config_align: create an AlignConfig combining text and vision configs for the ALIGN multimodal model
create_config_align_from_dicts: create an AlignConfig initialized from text and vision config dictionaries
build_align_model_config: build an ALIGN model configuration from text and vision sub-configs
